events.title: FOMC meeting and rate decision
events.why_it_matters: Fed is expected to hold rates but maintain a hawkish tilt as inflation stays above target and the labor market cools.
events.what_to_watch: Statement language on further tightening and any dissents; press conference tone on December.

events.title: China Fifth Plenum
events.why_it_matters: The plenum sets the policy framework for 2027 and could signal the next phase of stimulus and industrial policy.
events.what_to_watch: Communique language on consumption support, property, and local-government debt.

events.title: Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon earnings
events.why_it_matters: Three Magnificent Seven megacaps report; AI capex and cloud growth will set the tone for the entire tech sector.
events.what_to_watch: Azure/AWS growth rates, AI monetization commentary, and capex guidance.

events.title: ECB meeting and rate decision
events.why_it_matters: ECB is expected to hold at 2.5% despite inflation at 3.8%, weighing energy shock against weak growth.
events.what_to_watch: Lagarde's guidance on a possible December hike and reaction to bond-market stress.

events.title: Bank of Japan meeting
events.why_it_matters: BOJ is expected to hold at 1.25% but signal that a December hike remains on the table as inflation stays near 2%.
events.what_to_watch: Ueda's comments on wage-price dynamics and yen volatility.

events.title: US Q3 GDP advance estimate
events.why_it_matters: Consensus sees 3.1% growth, up from 2.2%, which would reinforce the soft-landing narrative.
events.what_to_watch: Consumer spending contribution and inventory build.

events.title: US September PCE inflation
events.why_it_matters: Core PCE is expected around 3.0% y/y, keeping the Fed's preferred inflation gauge well above target.
events.what_to_watch: Core services ex-housing and the monthly pace.

events.title: Eurozone Q3 GDP preliminary
events.why_it_matters: Growth is expected to slow to 0.2% q/q from 0.6%, highlighting the euro area's loss of momentum.
events.what_to_watch: Germany vs. France divergence and revisions to prior quarters.

events.title: China official October PMI
events.why_it_matters: Manufacturing PMI is expected near 50.3, a second month of expansion but still fragile.
events.what_to_watch: New orders, export orders, and employment sub-indices.

events.title: US ISM Manufacturing October
events.why_it_matters: Manufacturing remains soft; a sub-50 print would reinforce the sector's contraction.
events.what_to_watch: New orders and prices paid.

events.title: US October nonfarm payrolls
events.why_it_matters: Labor market cooling is the key argument for the Fed's hold; prior payrolls were only +29k.
events.what_to_watch: Unemployment rate, average hourly earnings, and revisions.

events.title: US October CPI
events.why_it_matters: CPI remains the single most important data point for Fed policy; sticky inflation would cement a hawkish hold.
events.what_to_watch: Core CPI m/m and shelter inflation.

events.title: Eurozone October flash CPI
events.why_it_matters: Inflation is running at 3.8% on energy costs, complicating the ECB's hold.
events.what_to_watch: Core inflation and services inflation pass-through.

events.title: Apple fiscal Q4 earnings
events.why_it_matters: First earnings under new CEO John Ternus; iPhone 18 cycle and AI strategy are in focus.
events.what_to_watch: Gross margin pressure from memory costs and services growth.

events.title: SK hynix and Samsung Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Combined operating profit is projected near a record 184 trillion won on AI memory demand.
events.what_to_watch: HBM4 shipment outlook and capex plans.

events.title: AMD Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: AMD is a key AI-chip beneficiary; guidance will be read against Nvidia and Intel.
events.what_to_watch: Data center GPU revenue and MI400 ramp commentary.

events.title: Visa and Coca-Cola earnings
events.why_it_matters: Payments and beverage bellwethers provide an early read on global consumer spending.
events.what_to_watch: Cross-border volumes and organic revenue growth.

events.title: Jio Platforms IPO listing
events.why_it_matters: India's largest-ever IPO lists after a 22x subscription, a landmark for EM equity risk appetite.
events.what_to_watch: Listing premium and subsequent index inclusion flows.

events.title: Anthropic IPO marketing begins
events.why_it_matters: A potential $2 trillion AI IPO could reset valuation benchmarks for the entire tech sector.
events.what_to_watch: Price range, demand signals, and whether the listing slips past November.

events.title: UK Autumn Budget
events.why_it_matters: Chancellor Healey's first Budget is a fiscal-credibility test amid surging inflation and gilt-market nerves.
events.what_to_watch: Gilt reaction, OBR forecasts, and capital-gains/tax measures.

events.title: US Treasury quarterly refunding
events.why_it_matters: Debt-management strategy, including long-end issuance and buybacks, could move Treasury yields.
events.what_to_watch: 20/30-year auction sizes and any shift toward bills.

events.title: US midterm elections
events.why_it_matters: Control of Congress will determine the legislative path for taxes, spending, and regulation.
events.what_to_watch: Senate swing states and House margin; implications for the 2027 policy agenda.

events.title: Supreme Court tariff oral arguments
events.why_it_matters: The Court will hear whether IEEPA grants the president authority for reciprocal tariffs; a ruling could reshape trade policy.
events.what_to_watch: Justices' questions on statutory delegation and major-questions doctrine.

events.title: CIT blocks 10% global tariff
events.why_it_matters: The Court of International Trade ruled the 10% global tariff illegal, a setback for the administration's trade agenda.
events.what_to_watch: Government appeal and parallel Supreme Court case.

events.title: Trump waives Russia sanctions and tariffs
events.why_it_matters: Trump waived tariffs and many sanctions under the Graham Act, easing immediate pressure on Russian crude buyers.
events.what_to_watch: Implementation details and Russia's response.

events.title: US federal government shutdown
events.why_it_matters: The shutdown has furloughed roughly 750,000 workers and forced FAA flight cuts, delaying data and weighing on growth.
events.what_to_watch: Negotiations over healthcare riders and the length of the lapse.

events.title: SEC crypto custody framework proposal
events.why_it_matters: The proposal would let registered advisers and funds custody crypto assets directly, a structural positive for the industry.
events.what_to_watch: Comment period and potential legal challenges.

events.title: FDA approves GSK's Hibsago
events.why_it_matters: First ASO drug approved for chronic hepatitis B, expanding GSK's antiviral franchise.
events.what_to_watch: Launch uptake and payer coverage.

events.title: FDA approves BioCryst's ORLADEYO pellets
events.why_it_matters: New oral pellet formulation for hereditary angioedema improves convenience and expands the label.
events.what_to_watch: Switching dynamics and sales trajectory.

events.title: Middle East conflict and Strait of Hormuz attacks
events.why_it_matters: October has been the most intense period of maritime attacks in Hormuz since March, keeping oil supply risk elevated.
events.what_to_watch: Escalation with Iran, tanker insurance rates, and OPEC+ response.

events.title: OPEC+ ministerial meeting
events.why_it_matters: The seven key OPEC+ members are expected to roll over November quotas amid supply disruptions and fragile demand.
events.what_to_watch: Compliance statements and any signal on December policy.

events.title: Japan general election outcome
events.why_it_matters: PM Takaichi's LDP won a two-thirds supermajority, providing political stability and a mandate for her agenda.
events.what_to_watch: Fiscal policy and BOJ coordination.

events.title: Argentina midterm elections
events.why_it_matters: Milei's first midterm test will shape the pace of market-friendly reforms.
events.what_to_watch: Results and the government's legislative strategy.

events.title: Hurricane Isaias aftermath
events.why_it_matters: Category 2 landfall near Destin caused insured losses and disrupted Gulf energy operations.
events.what_to_watch: Final insured-loss estimates and energy infrastructure repairs.

events.title: SEMICON Europa conference
events.why_it_matters: Europe's leading electronics manufacturing event will showcase AI, packaging, and MedTech chip advances.
events.what_to_watch: Announcements on advanced packaging and European fab investment.

top_risks: US government shutdown drags into November, delaying data and hitting GDP and aviation.
Middle East escalation in the Strait of Hormuz pushes oil sharply higher and feeds inflation.
Supreme Court upholds IEEPA tariffs, reviving trade-war uncertainty and import-cost pressure.
Hawkish Fed hold with sticky inflation triggers a sharp rise in real yields and equity de-rating.
US midterm outcome produces a divided government and a fiscal-policy standoff into 2027.
top_opportunities: Soft-landing confirmation from Q3 GDP and cooling payrolls supports risk assets.
AI earnings from Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, and SK hynix validate the capex supercycle.
Anthropic IPO and Jio listing signal healthy risk appetite for mega-cap new issues.
ECB and BOJ holds with dovish signals could weaken the euro and yen, boosting exporters.
Treasury refunding avoiding long-end supply shocks could cap yields and support duration.
summary: The scan is dominated by the ongoing US shutdown, a hawkish Fed hold, and a dense week of megacap tech earnings. The Middle East oil-risk premium remains live, while the Supreme Court tariff case and US midterms are the key regime-level events in early November. Data is running hot on inflation but soft on jobs, leaving the Fed in a prolonged hold.
